[attribute-index-type]
=== `@index-type` Type of Index

Names the specific indexes in which an index term (<<element-index-term,`<index-term>`>>) should be used, for example, “`materials`”, “`subject`”, “`chemical`”, “`regulations and code`”.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-index,`<index>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| A word or phrase| The name of the index, for example, “`species`”, “`chemical`”, “`subject`”, etc.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-index-term,`<index-term>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| One or more words| A word naming the index, or a series of words each representing a specific index.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
